name: Fakhr al-Dīn Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Jārabardī
summary: Shāfiʿī scholar of Tabriz whose commentary on Ibn al-Ḥājib's al-Shāfiya was one of the standard explanations of ṣarf in the madrasas.
bio: Al-Jārabardī taught in Tabriz under the Īlkhānids and wrote on law, Qurʾān commentary and grammar. His Sharḥ al-Shāfiya explains Ibn al-Ḥājib's book on ṣarf plainly and in order, and with the commentaries of al-Raḍī and Niẓām al-Dīn al-Nīsābūrī it was one of the three read beside the text; it is printed in the collection of the Shāfiya's commentaries (Majmūʿat al-Shāfiya). He also wrote glosses on al-Zamakhsharī's al-Kashshāf. He died in Tabriz in 746/1346.
